newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Lion Brewery announces allotment basis in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Lion Brewery announces allotment basis in IPO.

text.p: Ceylon Brewery Ltd shareholders will get priority in allotment of shares in the initial public offer (IPO) of Lion Brewery Ltd, Lion Brewery said in a statement on monday.
Ceylon Brewery shareholders have taken 66 percent of the 12.5 million Lion shares on offer, leaving only 34 percent for the public, the statement said.
Shareholders were entitled to seven Lion shares for every 10 Ceylon Brewery shares they held. Lion is a 50.4 percent subsidiary of Ceylon Brewery.
Lion Brewery made an initial offer of 12.5 million 10-rupee shares at 20 rupees each on November 28. The offer received applications for about 24 million shares in less than a day.

Under the allotments announced on Monday, applicants for 2,500 shares will get all they applied for. Applicants for 2,600 to 7,500 shares will get 2,500, applicants for 7,600 to 26,900 shares will get 5,500 and those seeking 27,000 or more will get 20.45 percent rounded up to the nearest 100 shares.
